schema_note: Workflow registry for the external verification tier. Surface ids are drawn mechanically from scripts/sdk_coverage.py: SURFACES (12), CENSUS_SURFACE (servicebus), CAP_CELLS (prefixed cap:, 7) — 20 inventory ids. Every inventory id must appear in >=1 workflow's surfaces[] or be covered by a cited kd_rows entry; orphans are listed in coverage.orphans. Unrecognized surface ids are parser findings. 'landed' is a tree-reconciliation marker: true = both language trees named in entry[] exist on disk.
notes: All five workflows landed (verified on disk 2026-10-19): verification/ts/wf{1..5}/index.ts and verification/py/test_wf{1,2,3,4,5}_{governance,concurrency,messaging,crypto,throttling}.py.

scripts/sdk_coverage.py still probes the legacy filename patterns verification/ts/*.probe.mjs and verification/py/py_*.py; the landed suites use wfN/index.ts and test_wfN_*.py, so all 24 probe cells read MISSING in the coverage gate. This is a finder-script pattern skew, not absence of probes — reconciling the finder patterns is owned by the sdk_coverage WO, not this registry.

Real open finding, owned by the Service Bus census work order; not fixable by registry edits.
